			Phone:       "+12065550111",
			Coordinates: domain.LocationPoint{Latitude: 47.6150, Longitude: -122.3200},
			RadiusMiles: 5.0,
			Channels:    []Channel{ChannelEmail, ChannelSMS},
		},
		{
			ID:          "sub-green-lake",
			Email:       "greenlake.resident@example.com",
			Phone:       "+12065550222",
			Coordinates: domain.LocationPoint{Latitude: 47.6800, Longitude: -122.3290},
			RadiusMiles: 5.0,
			Channels:    []Channel{ChannelEmail, ChannelPush},
		},
	}
}

// BroadcastLostPetAlert computes distance between lost pet location and subscribers, broadcasting urgent alerts to nearby residents.
func (g *GeoBroadcastEngine) BroadcastLostPetAlert(ctx context.Context, evt *domain.LostPetReportedV3, maxRadiusMiles float64) ([]DispatchResult, error) {
	return g.broadcastLostPetAlert(ctx, evt, maxRadiusMiles, g.dispatcher.Dispatch)
}

func (g *GeoBroadcastEngine) broadcastLostPetAlert(
	ctx context.Context,
	evt *domain.LostPetReportedV3,
	maxRadiusMiles float64,
	dispatch notificationDispatch,
) ([]DispatchResult, error) {
	if evt == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("evt cannot be nil")
	}
	if dispatch == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("notification dispatch cannot be nil")
	}
	if evt.GeocodingStatus != domain.GeocodingVerified {
		log.Printf("[GEO BROADCAST] Skipping lost pet %s because coordinates are not verified", evt.PetID)
		return []DispatchResult{}, nil
	}
	if evt.Coordinates == nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("verified lost pet %s has no coordinates", evt.PetID)
	}
	if err := evt.Coordinates.Validate(); err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("lost pet %s has invalid coordinates: %w", evt.PetID, err)
	}

	petPoint := *evt.Coordinates
	allResults := make([]DispatchResult, 0)

	log.Printf("[GEO BROADCAST] Processing lost pet %s near %s (Lat: %.4f, Lon: %.4f)",
		evt.PetID, evt.Location, petPoint.Latitude, petPoint.Longitude)

	for _, sub := range g.subscribers {
		distMiles := domain.HaversineDistanceMiles(petPoint, sub.Coordinates)

		// Check if subscriber is within requested radius and their own preference radius
		effectiveRadius := maxRadiusMiles
		if sub.RadiusMiles < effectiveRadius {
			effectiveRadius = sub.RadiusMiles
		}

		if distMiles <= effectiveRadius {
			log.Printf("[GEO BROADCAST] Subscriber %s is within %.2f miles (Threshold: %.2f mi). Dispatching alert...",
				sub.ID, distMiles, effectiveRadius)

			msg := &NotificationMessage{
				RecipientID: sub.ID,
				Email:       sub.Email,
				Phone:       sub.Phone,
				PushToken:   fmt.Sprintf("token-%s", sub.ID),
				Subject:     fmt.Sprintf("🚨 URGENT: Lost Pet Alert in Your Neighborhood (%s)", evt.Location),
				Body:        fmt.Sprintf("A pet (%s) was reported lost near %s (approx %.1f miles from you). Please keep an eye out!", evt.PetID, evt.Location, distMiles),
				Channels:    sub.Channels,
			}

			results, err := dispatch(ctx, msg)
			if err != nil {
				return allResults, fmt.Errorf("broadcast to subscriber %s: %w", sub.ID, err)
			}
			allResults = append(allResults, results...)
		} else {
			log.Printf("[GEO BROADCAST] Subscriber %s is %.2f miles away (Outside radius %.2f mi). Skipping.",
				sub.ID, distMiles, effectiveRadius)
		}
	}

	return allResults, nil
}

   109	// DecodeLostPetReported reads every lost-pet payload shape published by the
   110	// application and returns the normalized canonical integration event. Raw
   111	// payloads predate envelopes and are therefore interpreted as payload v1.
   112	func DecodeLostPetReported(data []byte) (LostPetReportedV3, *EventEnvelope, error) {
   113		var payload json.RawMessage
   114		envelope, err := DecodeEventPayload(data, EventTypeLostPetReported, &payload)
   115		if err != nil {
   116			return LostPetReportedV3{}, nil, err
   117		}
   118	
   119		payloadVersion := LostPetReportedLegacyPayloadVersion
   120		if envelope != nil {
   121			payloadVersion = envelope.PayloadVersion
   122		}
   123		var event LostPetReportedV3
   124		switch payloadVersion {
   125		case LostPetReportedLegacyPayloadVersion:
   126			var legacy LostPetEvent
   127			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &legacy); err != nil {
   128				return LostPetReportedV3{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: decode lost-pet payload v1: %w", err)
   129			}
   130			if err := legacy.Validate(); err != nil {
   131				return LostPetReportedV3{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid lost-pet payload v1: %w", err)
   132			}
   133			event = normalizeLostPetReportedV3(LostPetReportedV3{
   134				PetID:      legacy.PetID,
   135				ReportedAt: legacy.ReportedAt,
   136				Location:   legacy.Location,
   137			})
   138		case LostPetReportedContactPayloadVersion:
   139			var prior LostPetReportedV2
   140			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &prior); err != nil {
   141				return LostPetReportedV3{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: decode lost-pet payload v2: %w", err)
   142			}
   143			if err := prior.Validate(); err != nil {
   144				return LostPetReportedV3{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid lost-pet payload v2: %w", err)
   145			}
   146			event = normalizeLostPetReportedV3(prior.redacted())
   147		case LostPetReportedPayloadVersion:
   148			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &event); err != nil {
   149				return LostPetReportedV3{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: decode lost-pet payload v3: %w", err)
   150			}
   151			if err := event.Validate(); err != nil {
   152				return LostPetReportedV3{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid lost-pet payload v3: %w", err)
   153			}
   154			event = normalizeLostPetReportedV3(event)
   155		default:
   156			return LostPetReportedV3{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported lost-pet payload version %d", payloadVersion)
   157		}

   243			PayloadVersion:   domain.LostPetReportedPayloadVersion,
   244			Payload:          eventData,
   245		})

   247			return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to create event envelope: %w", err)
   248		}

   250		if err != nil {
   251			return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal event envelope: %w", err)

   231		}
   232		occurredAt := report.ReportedAt

    81	type FoundPetReportedV2 struct {
    82		PetID               string          `json:"petId"`
    83		ImageURL            string          `json:"imageUrl,omitempty"`

    98	// DecodeFoundPetReported reads every found-pet payload shape published by the
    99	// application and returns the normalized canonical integration event. Raw
   100	// payloads predate envelopes and are therefore interpreted as payload v1.
   101	func DecodeFoundPetReported(data []byte) (FoundPetReportedV2, *EventEnvelope, error) {
   102		var event FoundPetReportedV2
   103		envelope, err := DecodeEventPayload(data, EventTypeFoundPetReported, &event)
   104		if err != nil {
   105			return FoundPetReportedV2{}, nil, err
   106		}
   107	
   108		payloadVersion := FoundPetReportedLegacyPayloadVersion
   109		if envelope != nil {
   110			payloadVersion = envelope.PayloadVersion
   111		}
   112		switch payloadVersion {
   113		case FoundPetReportedLegacyPayloadVersion:
   114			legacy := FoundPetEvent{
   115				PetID:       event.PetID,
   116				ImageURL:    event.ImageURL,
   117				ImageObject: event.ImageObject,
   118				FoundAt:     event.FoundAt,
   119				Location:    event.Location,
   120			}
   121			if err := legacy.Validate(); err != nil {
   122				return FoundPetReportedV2{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid found-pet payload v1: %w", err)
   123			}
   124			event = normalizeFoundPetReported(FoundPetReportedV2{
   125				PetID:       legacy.PetID,
   126				ImageURL:    legacy.ImageURL,
   127				ImageObject: legacy.ImageObject,
   128				FoundAt:     legacy.FoundAt,
   129				Location:    legacy.Location,
   130			})
   131		case FoundPetReportedPayloadVersion:
   132			if err := event.Validate(); err != nil {
   133				return FoundPetReportedV2{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid found-pet payload v%d: %w", payloadVersion, err)
   134			}
   135			event = normalizeFoundPetReported(event)
   136		default:

    98	// DecodeFoundPetReported reads every found-pet payload shape published by the
    99	// application and returns the normalized canonical integration event. Raw
   100	// payloads predate envelopes and are therefore interpreted as payload v1.
   101	func DecodeFoundPetReported(data []byte) (FoundPetReportedV2, *EventEnvelope, error) {
   102		var event FoundPetReportedV2
   103		envelope, err := DecodeEventPayload(data, EventTypeFoundPetReported, &event)
   104		if err != nil {
   105			return FoundPetReportedV2{}, nil, err
   106		}
   107	
   108		payloadVersion := FoundPetReportedLegacyPayloadVersion
   109		if envelope != nil {
   110			payloadVersion = envelope.PayloadVersion
   111		}
   112		switch payloadVersion {
   113		case FoundPetReportedLegacyPayloadVersion:
   114			legacy := FoundPetEvent{
   115				PetID:       event.PetID,
   116				ImageURL:    event.ImageURL,
   117				ImageObject: event.ImageObject,
   118				FoundAt:     event.FoundAt,
   119				Location:    event.Location,
   120			}
   121			if err := legacy.Validate(); err != nil {
   122				return FoundPetReportedV2{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid found-pet payload v1: %w", err)
   123			}
   124			event = normalizeFoundPetReported(FoundPetReportedV2{
   125				PetID:       legacy.PetID,
   126				ImageURL:    legacy.ImageURL,
   127				ImageObject: legacy.ImageObject,
   128				FoundAt:     legacy.FoundAt,
   129				Location:    legacy.Location,
   130			})
   131		case FoundPetReportedPayloadVersion:
   132			if err := event.Validate(); err != nil {
   133				return FoundPetReportedV2{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid found-pet payload v%d: %w", payloadVersion, err)
   134			}
   135			event = normalizeFoundPetReported(event)
   136		default:
   137			return FoundPetReportedV2{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported found-pet payload version %d", payloadVersion)
   138		}
   139		if envelope != nil && strings.TrimSpace(envelope.AggregateID) != event.PetID {

   227		if err := legacy.Validate(); err != nil {

   236		if err := validateFoundPetLengths(r); err != nil {

   240			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported species %q", r.Species)

   242		switch r.CustodyStatus {

   248			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported found-pet status %q", r.Status)
   249		}
   250		switch r.GeocodingStatus {
   251		case GeocodingPending:
   252			if r.Coordinates != nil {
   253				return errors.New("domain: pending geocoding cannot include coordinates")
   254			}

   256			if r.Coordinates != nil {

   267			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported geocoding status %q", r.GeocodingStatus)

   109	func (s *Service) HandleLostPet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
   110		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
   111			respondWithError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "Method not allowed")
   112			return
   113		}
   114	
   115		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 1048576)
   116	
   117		var request struct {
   118			PetID           string                 `json:"petId"`
   119			PetName         string                 `json:"petName"`
   120			Species         string                 `json:"species"`
   121			Breed           string                 `json:"breed"`
   122			PrimaryColor    string                 `json:"primaryColor"`
   123			Description     string                 `json:"description"`
   124			ReporterEmail   string                 `json:"reporterEmail"`
   125			Phone           string                 `json:"phone"`
   126			ReportedAt      time.Time              `json:"reportedAt"`
   127			Location        string                 `json:"location"`
   128			GeocodingStatus domain.GeocodingStatus `json:"geocodingStatus"`
   129			Coordinates     *domain.LocationPoint  `json:"coordinates"`
   130		}
   131		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request); err != nil {
   132			respondWithError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Invalid JSON payload: %v", err))
   133			return
   134		}
   135	
   136		result, err := s.ReportLostPet(r.Context(), ReportCommand{
   137			PetID:           request.PetID,
   138			PetName:         request.PetName,
   139			Species:         request.Species,
   140			Breed:           request.Breed,
   141			PrimaryColor:    request.PrimaryColor,
   142			Description:     request.Description,
   143			ReporterEmail:   request.ReporterEmail,
   144			Phone:           request.Phone,
   145			ReportedAt:      request.ReportedAt,
   146			Location:        request.Location,
   147			GeocodingStatus: request.GeocodingStatus,
   148			Coordinates:     request.Coordinates,
   149		}, ReportMetadata{
   150			CorrelationID: r.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID"),
   151			TraceID:       r.Header.Get("X-Trace-ID"),
   152		})
   153		switch {
   154		case errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidReport):
   155			respondWithError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Event validation failed: %v", InvalidReportCause(err)))
   156			return
   157		case errors.Is(err, store.ErrConflict):
   158			respondWithError(w, http.StatusConflict, "A different report already exists for this pet ID")
   159			return
   160		case err != nil:
   161			respondWithError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
   162			return
   163		}
   164	
   165		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   166		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
   167		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
   168			"status":  "success",
   169			"petId":   result.PetID,
   170			"eventId": result.EventID,
   171		})
   172	}

    26	type StorageRuntime struct {

    38	// LoadStorageConfig loads and validates image-storage configuration.
    39	func LoadStorageConfig(lookup func(string) string) (StorageConfig, error) {
    40		mode, _, err := resolveRuntimeMode(lookup)
    41		if err != nil {
    42			return StorageConfig{}, err
    43		}
    44		config := StorageConfig{
    45			Mode:                mode,
    46			BucketName:          strings.TrimSpace(lookup("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET")),
    47			StorageEmulatorHost: strings.TrimSpace(lookup("STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST")),
    48			MemoryBaseURL:       strings.TrimSpace(lookup("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BASE_URL")),
    49		}
    50		switch config.Mode {
    51		case ModeMemory:
    52			return StorageConfig{Mode: ModeMemory, MemoryBaseURL: config.MemoryBaseURL}, nil
    53		case ModeLocalEmulator:
    54			if config.BucketName == "" || config.StorageEmulatorHost == "" {
    55				return StorageConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET and STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST are required in %q mode", config.Mode)
    56			}

    62				return StorageConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST must not be set in %q mode", config.Mode)
    63			}
    64		}
    65		return config, nil
    66	}

    68	// NewStorageRuntime selects memory, emulator, or managed private image storage.
    69	func NewStorageRuntime(ctx context.Context, config StorageConfig) (*StorageRuntime, error) {
    70		if err := validateStorageConfig(config); err != nil {
    71			return nil, err
    72		}
    73		switch config.Mode {
    74		case ModeMemory:
    75			baseURL := strings.TrimSpace(config.MemoryBaseURL)
    76			if baseURL == "" {
    77				baseURL = "http://localhost/images"
    78			}
    79			return &StorageRuntime{
    80				Images: blob.NewMemoryBlobStore(baseURL), close: func() error { return nil },
    81			}, nil
    82		case ModeLocalEmulator:
    83			privateKey, err := localSigningKey()
    84			if err != nil {
    85				return nil, err
    86			}
    87			images, err := blob.NewGCSImageStore(ctx, blob.GCSConfig{
    88				BucketName: config.BucketName, Endpoint: config.StorageEmulatorHost,
    89				GoogleAccessID: "local-emulator@petspotr.invalid", PrivateKey: privateKey,

    91			if err != nil {

    93			}
    94			return &StorageRuntime{Images: images, close: images.Close}, nil
    95		case ModeGCP:

    97			if err != nil {
    98				return nil, err
    99			}
   100			return &StorageRuntime{Images: images, close: images.Close}, nil
   101		default:

   119			}

   121				!strings.HasPrefix(config.StorageEmulatorHost, "https://") {
   122				return fmt.Errorf("STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST must be an HTTP(S) URL in %q mode", config.Mode)
   123			}
   124			return nil

   131			}
   132			return nil
   133		default:

   135		}
   136	}

   138	func localSigningKey() ([]byte, error) {
   139		key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)

   142		}

   144			Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(key),
   145		}), nil
   146	}

    19		Mode                Mode

    21		StorageEmulatorHost string
    22		MemoryBaseURL       string
    23	}
    24	
    25	// StorageRuntime owns the selected image store and its client lifecycle.
    26	type StorageRuntime struct {
    27		Images    blob.ImageStore
    28		close     func() error
    29		closeOnce sync.Once
    30		closeErr  error
    31	}
    32	
    33	// LoadStorageConfigFromEnv loads image-storage configuration from the process.
    34	func LoadStorageConfigFromEnv() (StorageConfig, error) {
    35		return LoadStorageConfig(os.Getenv)
    36	}
    37	
    38	// LoadStorageConfig loads and validates image-storage configuration.
    39	func LoadStorageConfig(lookup func(string) string) (StorageConfig, error) {
    40		mode, _, err := resolveRuntimeMode(lookup)
    41		if err != nil {
    42			return StorageConfig{}, err
    43		}
    44		config := StorageConfig{
    45			Mode:                mode,
    46			BucketName:          strings.TrimSpace(lookup("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET")),
    47			StorageEmulatorHost: strings.TrimSpace(lookup("STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST")),
    48			MemoryBaseURL:       strings.TrimSpace(lookup("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BASE_URL")),
    49		}
    50		switch config.Mode {
    51		case ModeMemory:
    52			return StorageConfig{Mode: ModeMemory, MemoryBaseURL: config.MemoryBaseURL}, nil
    53		case ModeLocalEmulator:
    54			if config.BucketName == "" || config.StorageEmulatorHost == "" {
    55				return StorageConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET and STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST are required in %q mode", config.Mode)
    56			}
    57		case ModeGCP:
    58			if config.BucketName == "" {
    59				return StorageConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET is required in %q mode", config.Mode)
    60			}
    61			if config.StorageEmulatorHost != "" {
    62				return StorageConfig{}, fmt.Errorf("STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST must not be set in %q mode", config.Mode)
    63			}
    64		}
    65		return config, nil
    66	}
    67	
    68	// NewStorageRuntime selects memory, emulator, or managed private image storage.
    69	func NewStorageRuntime(ctx context.Context, config StorageConfig) (*StorageRuntime, error) {
    70		if err := validateStorageConfig(config); err != nil {
    71			return nil, err
    72		}
    73		switch config.Mode {
    74		case ModeMemory:
    75			baseURL := strings.TrimSpace(config.MemoryBaseURL)
    76			if baseURL == "" {
    77				baseURL = "http://localhost/images"
    78			}
    79			return &StorageRuntime{
    80				Images: blob.NewMemoryBlobStore(baseURL), close: func() error { return nil },
    81			}, nil
    82		case ModeLocalEmulator:
    83			privateKey, err := localSigningKey()
    84			if err != nil {
    85				return nil, err
    86			}
    87			images, err := blob.NewGCSImageStore(ctx, blob.GCSConfig{
    88				BucketName: config.BucketName, Endpoint: config.StorageEmulatorHost,
    89				GoogleAccessID: "local-emulator@petspotr.invalid", PrivateKey: privateKey,
    90			})
    91			if err != nil {
    92				return nil, err
    93			}
    94			return &StorageRuntime{Images: images, close: images.Close}, nil
    95		case ModeGCP:
    96			images, err := blob.NewGCSImageStore(ctx, blob.GCSConfig{BucketName: config.BucketName})
    97			if err != nil {
    98				return nil, err
    99			}
   100			return &StorageRuntime{Images: images, close: images.Close}, nil
   101		default:
   102			return nil, fmt.Errorf("unsupported runtime mode %q", config.Mode)
   103		}
   104	}

   106	// Close releases the image-store client once.
   107	func (r *StorageRuntime) Close() error {
   108		r.closeOnce.Do(func() { r.closeErr = r.close() })
   109		return r.closeErr
   110	}

   112	func validateStorageConfig(config StorageConfig) error {
   113		switch config.Mode {
   114		case ModeMemory:
   115			return nil
   116		case ModeLocalEmulator:
   117			if config.BucketName == "" || config.StorageEmulatorHost == "" {
   118				return fmt.Errorf("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET and STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST are required in %q mode", config.Mode)
   119			}
   120			if !strings.HasPrefix(config.StorageEmulatorHost, "http://") &&
   121				!strings.HasPrefix(config.StorageEmulatorHost, "https://") {
   122				return fmt.Errorf("STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST must be an HTTP(S) URL in %q mode", config.Mode)
   123			}
   124			return nil
   125		case ModeGCP:
   126			if config.BucketName == "" {
   127				return fmt.Errorf("PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET is required in %q mode", config.Mode)
   128			}
   129			if config.StorageEmulatorHost != "" {
   130				return fmt.Errorf("STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST must not be set in %q mode", config.Mode)
   131			}
   132			return nil
   133		default:
   134			return fmt.Errorf("unsupported runtime mode %q", config.Mode)
   135		}
   136	}
   137	
   138	func localSigningKey() ([]byte, error) {
   139		key, err := rsa.GenerateKey(rand.Reader, 2048)
   140		if err != nil {
   141			return nil, fmt.Errorf("generate local image signing key: %w", err)
   142		}
   143		return pem.EncodeToMemory(&pem.Block{
   144			Type: "RSA PRIVATE KEY", Bytes: x509.MarshalPKCS1PrivateKey(key),
   145		}), nil
   146	}

   223	
   224	The Pub/Sub emulator does not implement IAM, so this contract uses the static
   225	development token on the push URL. Unit tests independently enforce exact OIDC
   226	service-account identity, verified-email, audience, and invalid-signature
   227	handling. Never configure `PUBSUB_PUSH_DEV_TOKEN` in GCP mode.
   228	Cloud Run rejects both local runtime modes even when they are explicitly set.
   229	Managed `lostPet`, `foundPet`, and `matchFound` subscriptions own transport
   230	retry and DLQ routing; issue #91 retains provider circuit-breaker work.
   231	
   232	### Private image storage
   233	
   234	The found-pet service and pet matcher select image storage with the same
   235	`PETSPOTR_RUNTIME_MODE` contract:
   236	
   237	| Mode | Required configuration | Image backend |
   238	| --- | --- | --- |
   239	| `memory` | Optional `PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BASE_URL` | Process-local compatibility store |
   240	| `local-emulator` | `PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET`, `STORAGE_EMULATOR_HOST` as an HTTP(S) URL | GCS-compatible local emulator |
   241	| `gcp` | `PETSPOTR_IMAGE_BUCKET`, Application Default Credentials | Private managed GCS bucket |
   242	
   243	Managed mode rejects an emulator endpoint and never falls back to memory.
   244	Cloud Run receives the bucket name from OpenTofu. Its found-pet identity has
   245	object-user access and may sign short-lived policies through IAM Credentials;
   246	the matcher has read-only object access.
   247	
   248	The secure found-pet flow is:
   249	
   250	1. `POST /foundPet/uploads` with `purpose: "found-pet"` and a JPEG or PNG
   251	   content type. The service ignores the caller filename and returns a
   252	   cryptographically generated report ID, temporary object name, and V4 POST
   253	   policy fields. It also returns a separate `finalizeToken`; only its SHA-256
   254	   digest is signed into object metadata.
   255	2. Multipart POST the file and every returned field to `uploadUrl`. The policy
   256	   expires after 15 minutes and binds the exact object, media type, report
   257	   metadata, finalization deadline, and a 1 byte through 10 MiB size range.
   258	3. `POST /foundPet` using the returned `reportId` as `petId` and temporary
   259	   `objectName` as `imageObject`, and send the raw capability in
   260	   `X-PetSpotR-Upload-Token`. Before creating report state or its outbox, the
   261	   service checks the capability in constant time plus immutable GCS
   262	   generation, size, metadata, detected media type, decoded dimensions, and
   263	   report binding. The signed finalization deadline remains enforced after the
   264	   object is copied, and the whole report operation has a two-minute server
   265	   deadline. It then copies the object to the private finalized namespace and
   266	   deletes the temporary object. The raw capability is never persisted in GCS
   267	   metadata or the durable event.
   268	
   269	Durable events store only the finalized object name. The matcher reads that
   270	private object with its service identity and base64-encodes the bytes for
   271	Ollama; no public or expiring URL is placed in an event. Private read URLs are
   272	V4-signed and capped at 15 minutes. Existing URL events remain readable during
   273	the schema migration, but managed found-pet report creation rejects them.
   274	
   275	The bucket enforces public access prevention and uniform access. Set
   276	`image_cors_allowed_origins` to exact deployed web origins; the default empty
   277	list permits no browser origin. Unfinalized `uploads/` objects are deleted
   278	after one day. The found-pet process also reconciles at most 100 finalized
   279	objects per pass with a cursor. After a 24-hour grace period—well beyond the
   280	15-minute capability and two-minute report deadlines—it deletes an object only
   281	when two durable-state checks find no report referencing the exact name and the
   282	object generation is unchanged. This recovers the crash window between GCS
   283	finalization and the Firestore report transaction without deleting active,
   284	referenced, or replaced objects. The capability authenticates the generated
   285	report upload; tying that capability to a signed-in user remains tracked by
   286	issue #110. Routing the browser through the canonical service remains tracked
   287	by issue #113.
   288	
   289	An opt-in deployed contract exercises signing, upload, finalization, private
   290	service reads, and a signed read URL against a real bucket:

   297	The test creates uniquely named objects and deletes its finalized object. Use

   300	### Live Ollama scoring
   301	
   302	An independent opt-in contract exercises the scoring pipeline against a live

   304	set `OLLAMA_HOST` to its base URL) and pull the model required by this test:

   313	GO_INTEGRATION_OLLAMA=1 \

   278	// FinalizeImage validates an uploaded image and moves it into the private image namespace.
   279	func (m *MemoryBlobStore) FinalizeImage(ctx context.Context, reportID, objectName, finalizeToken string) (*FinalizedImage, error) {
   280		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   281			return nil, err
   282		}
   283	
   284		m.mu.Lock()
   285		defer m.mu.Unlock()
   286	
   287		if finalName, ok := m.finalizedByUpload[objectName]; ok {
   288			finalized := m.finalized[finalName]
   289			if finalizedReportID(finalized.ObjectName) != reportID || !tokenMatches(m.finalizeTokens[objectName], finalizeToken) {
   290				return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   291			}
   292			if !m.now().UTC().Before(m.finalizeBefore[objectName]) {
   293				return nil, ErrUploadExpired
   294			}
   295			return cloneFinalized(finalized), nil
   296		}
   297	
   298		pending, ok := m.pending[objectName]
   299		if !ok || pending.reportID != reportID || !tokenMatches(pending.tokenDigest, finalizeToken) {
   300			return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   301		}
   302		if !m.now().UTC().Before(pending.expiresAt) {
   303			return nil, ErrUploadExpired
   304		}
   305		data, ok := m.blobs[objectName]
   306		if !ok {
   307			return nil, ErrNotFound
   308		}
   309		width, height, err := validateImage(data, pending.contentType)
   310		if err != nil {
   311			return nil, err
   312		}
   313		finalized := FinalizedImage{
   314			ObjectName:  pending.finalName,
   315			ContentType: pending.contentType,
   316			Size:        int64(len(data)),
   317			Width:       width,
   318			Height:      height,
   319			Generation:  1,
   320		}
   321		m.blobs[pending.finalName] = bytes.Clone(data)
   322		delete(m.blobs, objectName)
   323		delete(m.pending, objectName)
   324		m.finalized[pending.finalName] = finalized
   325		m.finalizedByUpload[objectName] = pending.finalName
   326		m.finalizeTokens[objectName] = pending.tokenDigest
   327		m.finalizeBefore[objectName] = pending.expiresAt
   328		return cloneFinalized(finalized), nil
   329	}

   369	func validateImage(data []byte, contentType string) (int, int, error) {
   370		if len(data) == 0 || int64(len(data)) > MaxImageBytes {
   371			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: size must be between 1 and %d bytes", ErrInvalidImage, MaxImageBytes)
   372		}
   373		if detected := http.DetectContentType(data); detected != contentType {
   374			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: declared %s but detected %s", ErrInvalidImage, contentType, detected)
   375		}
   376		config, format, err := image.DecodeConfig(bytes.NewReader(data))
   377		if err != nil {
   378			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: decode configuration: %w", ErrInvalidImage, err)
   379		}
   380		wantFormat := "jpeg"
   381		if contentType == "image/png" {
   382			wantFormat = "png"
   383		}
   384		if format != wantFormat || config.Width <= 0 || config.Height <= 0 ||
   385			config.Width > maxImageDimension || config.Height > maxImageDimension ||
   386			int64(config.Width)*int64(config.Height) > maxImagePixels {
   387			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported image dimensions or encoding", ErrInvalidImage)
   388		}
   389		return config.Width, config.Height, nil
   390	}

   392	func supportedImageType(value string) (string, string, bool) {
   393		contentType := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.SplitN(value, ";", 2)[0]))
   394		switch contentType {
   395		case "image/jpeg":
   396			return contentType, ".jpg", true
   397		case "image/png":
   398			return contentType, ".png", true
   399		default:
   400			return "", "", false
   401		}
   402	}

   404	func randomHex(bytesCount int) (string, error) {
   405		value := make([]byte, bytesCount)
   406		if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
   407			return "", fmt.Errorf("blob: generate random identifier: %w", err)
   408		}
   409		return hex.EncodeToString(value), nil
   410	}

   412	func tokenDigest(token string) string {
   413		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(token))
   414		return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
   415	}
   416	
   417	func tokenMatches(wantDigest, token string) bool {
   418		gotDigest := tokenDigest(token)
   419		return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(wantDigest), []byte(gotDigest)) == 1
   420	}

   422	func finalizedReportID(objectName string) string {
   423		parts := strings.Split(objectName, "/")

   426		}
   427		return ""
   428	}

   278	// FinalizeImage validates an uploaded image and moves it into the private image namespace.
   279	func (m *MemoryBlobStore) FinalizeImage(ctx context.Context, reportID, objectName, finalizeToken string) (*FinalizedImage, error) {
   280		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   281			return nil, err
   282		}
   283	
   284		m.mu.Lock()
   285		defer m.mu.Unlock()
   286	
   287		if finalName, ok := m.finalizedByUpload[objectName]; ok {
   288			finalized := m.finalized[finalName]
   289			if finalizedReportID(finalized.ObjectName) != reportID || !tokenMatches(m.finalizeTokens[objectName], finalizeToken) {
   290				return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   291			}
   292			if !m.now().UTC().Before(m.finalizeBefore[objectName]) {
   293				return nil, ErrUploadExpired
   294			}
   295			return cloneFinalized(finalized), nil
   296		}
   297	
   298		pending, ok := m.pending[objectName]
   299		if !ok || pending.reportID != reportID || !tokenMatches(pending.tokenDigest, finalizeToken) {
   300			return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   301		}
   302		if !m.now().UTC().Before(pending.expiresAt) {
   303			return nil, ErrUploadExpired
   304		}
   305		data, ok := m.blobs[objectName]
   306		if !ok {
   307			return nil, ErrNotFound
   308		}
   309		width, height, err := validateImage(data, pending.contentType)
   310		if err != nil {
   311			return nil, err
   312		}
   313		finalized := FinalizedImage{
   314			ObjectName:  pending.finalName,
   315			ContentType: pending.contentType,
   316			Size:        int64(len(data)),
   317			Width:       width,
   318			Height:      height,
   319			Generation:  1,
   320		}
   321		m.blobs[pending.finalName] = bytes.Clone(data)
   322		delete(m.blobs, objectName)
   323		delete(m.pending, objectName)
   324		m.finalized[pending.finalName] = finalized
   325		m.finalizedByUpload[objectName] = pending.finalName
   326		m.finalizeTokens[objectName] = pending.tokenDigest
   327		m.finalizeBefore[objectName] = pending.expiresAt
   328		return cloneFinalized(finalized), nil
   329	}

   331	// GenerateImageReadURL returns a short-lived capability for a finalized private object.
   332	func (m *MemoryBlobStore) GenerateImageReadURL(ctx context.Context, objectName string, expiry time.Duration) (string, error) {
   333		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   334			return "", err
   335		}
   336		m.mu.RLock()
   337		_, ok := m.finalized[objectName]
   338		m.mu.RUnlock()
   339		if !ok {
   340			return "", ErrNotFinalized
   341		}
   342		if expiry <= 0 || expiry > maxReadExpiry {
   343			expiry = maxReadExpiry
   344		}

   369	func validateImage(data []byte, contentType string) (int, int, error) {
   370		if len(data) == 0 || int64(len(data)) > MaxImageBytes {
   371			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: size must be between 1 and %d bytes", ErrInvalidImage, MaxImageBytes)
   372		}
   373		if detected := http.DetectContentType(data); detected != contentType {
   374			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: declared %s but detected %s", ErrInvalidImage, contentType, detected)
   375		}
   376		config, format, err := image.DecodeConfig(bytes.NewReader(data))
   377		if err != nil {
   378			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: decode configuration: %w", ErrInvalidImage, err)
   379		}
   380		wantFormat := "jpeg"
   381		if contentType == "image/png" {
   382			wantFormat = "png"
   383		}
   384		if format != wantFormat || config.Width <= 0 || config.Height <= 0 ||
   385			config.Width > maxImageDimension || config.Height > maxImageDimension ||
   386			int64(config.Width)*int64(config.Height) > maxImagePixels {
   387			return 0, 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported image dimensions or encoding", ErrInvalidImage)
   388		}
   389		return config.Width, config.Height, nil
   390	}

   392	func supportedImageType(value string) (string, string, bool) {
   393		contentType := strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(strings.SplitN(value, ";", 2)[0]))
   394		switch contentType {
   395		case "image/jpeg":
   396			return contentType, ".jpg", true
   397		case "image/png":
   398			return contentType, ".png", true
   399		default:
   400			return "", "", false
   401		}
   402	}
   403	
   404	func randomHex(bytesCount int) (string, error) {
   405		value := make([]byte, bytesCount)
   406		if _, err := rand.Read(value); err != nil {
   407			return "", fmt.Errorf("blob: generate random identifier: %w", err)
   408		}
   409		return hex.EncodeToString(value), nil
   410	}
   411	
   412	func tokenDigest(token string) string {
   413		digest := sha256.Sum256([]byte(token))
   414		return hex.EncodeToString(digest[:])
   415	}
   416	
   417	func tokenMatches(wantDigest, token string) bool {
   418		gotDigest := tokenDigest(token)
   419		return subtle.ConstantTimeCompare([]byte(wantDigest), []byte(gotDigest)) == 1
   420	}

   422	func finalizedReportID(objectName string) string {
   423		parts := strings.Split(objectName, "/")
   424		if len(parts) == 4 && parts[0] == "images" && parts[1] == "found-pets" {
   425			return parts[2]
   426		}
   427		return ""
   428	}

   431		clone := value
   432		return &clone
   433	}

   138	use the same runtime-mode selection as state:

   141	runtime reuses one publisher handle per topic, waits for Pub/Sub to acknowledge
   142	each event, and closes every publisher handle before closing the shared client.
   143	Topics and subscriptions must already exist; production infrastructure and the
   144	emulator contracts create them explicitly.
   145

   147	the legacy raw payload and payload version 1 while those messages can remain in
   148	flight. Found-pet producers emit additive payload version 2. Lost-pet producers
   149	emit contact-redacted payload version 3; its decoder continues to accept raw
   150	and enveloped payload version 1 plus the prior contact-bearing payload version
   151	2. Private phone and finder-contact data are never copied into report events,
   152	and current lost-pet events also omit reporter email. Removing or renaming a
   153	published field requires a new payload version and a tolerant decoder for every
   154	supported prior shape.
   155	
   156	Deploy the lost-pet payload-version-3 rollout consumer first: update
   157	`notification-service` so it accepts lost-pet payload versions 1, 2, and 3.
   158	Only after that revision is serving should `lostpet-service` and
   159	`web-frontend` be deployed to publish version 3. The consumer-first order keeps
   160	in-flight version-1 and version-2 events readable and prevents old consumers
   161	from rejecting the contact-redacted payload.

   164	canonical payload-version readers. Those readers normalize raw legacy and
   165	payload-version-1 messages without trusting fields that did not exist in that
   166	schema. Community broadcasts require `verified` geocoding plus validated
   167	coordinates; older messages and pending locations are accepted but do not
   168	trigger a broadcast or receive an invented fallback location.

   177	different from `PUBSUB_PUSH_SUBSCRIPTION` so each route is bound to exactly one
   178	managed subscription.

   181	verified email is that consumer's configured invocation service account. The
   182	subscription name in the wrapped push body must also match. A handler returns
   183	`204` only after processing succeeds. Transient provider failures and invalid
   184	event payloads return `500` for redelivery and eventual DLQ routing; malformed
   185	Pub/Sub wrappers and mismatched delivery metadata return `400` and are also
   186	unacknowledged.

   192	  gcr.io/google.com/cloudsdktool/google-cloud-cli:emulators \
   193	  gcloud beta emulators pubsub start \
   194	  --host-port=127.0.0.1:8086 \
   195	  --project=petspotr-push-contract
   196	```
   197

   199	
   200	```bash
   201	PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8086 \
   202	  go test ./e2e \
   203	  -run TestPubSubEmulatorRedeliversWrappedMessageUntilHandlerSucceeds
   204	```

   207	endpoint. It verifies a transient channel failure is retried without repeating
   208	completed channels, then confirms a poison event is redelivered:
   209	
   210	```bash
   211	PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8086 \
   212	  go test ./internal/app/notification \
   213	  -run TestNotificationPubSubEmulatorDeliversRetriesAndRetainsPoison
   214	```

   216	Run the equivalent `lostPet` community-broadcast contract with:
   217	
   218	```bash
   219	PUBSUB_EMULATOR_HOST=127.0.0.1:8086 \
   220	  go test ./internal/app/notification \
   221	  -run TestNotificationLostPetPubSubEmulatorDeliversRetriesAndRetainsPoison
   222	```
   223

   225	development token on the push URL. Unit tests independently enforce exact OIDC

   131	// DecodeLostPetReported reads every lost-pet payload shape published by the
   132	// application and returns the normalized canonical integration event. Raw
   133	// payloads predate envelopes and are therefore interpreted as payload v1.
   134	func DecodeLostPetReported(data []byte) (LostPetReportedV4, *EventEnvelope, error) {
   135		var payload json.RawMessage
   136		envelope, err := DecodeEventPayload(data, EventTypeLostPetReported, &payload)
   137		if err != nil {
   138			return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, err
   139		}
   140	
   141		payloadVersion := LostPetReportedLegacyPayloadVersion
   142		if envelope != nil {
   143			payloadVersion = envelope.PayloadVersion
   144		}
   145		var event LostPetReportedV4
   146		switch payloadVersion {
   147		case LostPetReportedLegacyPayloadVersion:
   148			var legacy LostPetEvent
   149			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &legacy); err != nil {
   150				return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: decode lost-pet payload v1: %w", err)
   151			}
   152			if err := legacy.Validate(); err != nil {
   153				return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid lost-pet payload v1: %w", err)
   154			}
   155			event = normalizeLostPetReportedV4(LostPetReportedV4{
   156				PetID:      legacy.PetID,
   157				ReportedAt: legacy.ReportedAt,
   158				Location:   legacy.Location,
   159			})
   160		case LostPetReportedContactPayloadVersion:
   161			var prior LostPetReportedV2
   162			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &prior); err != nil {
   163				return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: decode lost-pet payload v2: %w", err)
   164			}
   165			if err := prior.Validate(); err != nil {
   166				return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid lost-pet payload v2: %w", err)
   167			}
   168			event = normalizeLostPetReportedV4(prior.redacted().current())
   169		case LostPetReportedRedactedPayloadVersion:
   170			var prior LostPetReportedV3
   171			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &prior); err != nil {
   172				return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: decode lost-pet payload v3: %w", err)
   173			}
   174			if err := prior.Validate(); err != nil {
   175				return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid lost-pet payload v3: %w", err)
   176			}
   177			event = normalizeLostPetReportedV4(prior.current())
   178		case LostPetReportedPayloadVersion:
   179			if err := json.Unmarshal(payload, &event); err != nil {
   180				return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: decode lost-pet payload v4: %w", err)
   181			}
   182			if err := event.Validate(); err != nil {
   183				return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: invalid lost-pet payload v4: %w", err)
   184			}
   185			event = normalizeLostPetReportedV4(event)
   186		default:
   187			return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported lost-pet payload version %d", payloadVersion)
   188		}
   189		if envelope != nil && strings.TrimSpace(envelope.AggregateID) != event.PetID {
   190			return LostPetReportedV4{}, nil, errors.New("domain: lost-pet aggregate ID does not match payload")
   191		}
   192		return event, envelope, nil
   193	}

   288	// NormalizeLostPetReport canonicalizes user-supplied values before validation,
   289	// persistence, event identity derivation, and retry comparison.
   290	func NormalizeLostPetReport(report LostPetReport) LostPetReport {
   291		report.PetID = strings.TrimSpace(report.PetID)
   292		report.PetName = strings.TrimSpace(report.PetName)
   293		report.Species = normalizeSpecies(report.Species)
   294		report.Breed = strings.TrimSpace(report.Breed)
   295		report.PrimaryColor = strings.TrimSpace(report.PrimaryColor)
   296		report.Description = strings.TrimSpace(report.Description)
   297		report.ReporterEmail = strings.ToLower(strings.TrimSpace(report.ReporterEmail))
   298		report.Phone = strings.TrimSpace(report.Phone)
   299		report.ImageObject = strings.TrimSpace(report.ImageObject)
   300		report.Location = strings.TrimSpace(report.Location)
   301		if !report.ReportedAt.IsZero() {
   302			report.ReportedAt = report.ReportedAt.UTC()
   303		}
   304		if report.Status == "" {
   305			report.Status = LostPetStatusLost
   306		}
   307		if report.GeocodingStatus == "" {
   308			if report.Location == "" {
   309				report.GeocodingStatus = GeocodingUnavailable
   310			} else {
   311				report.GeocodingStatus = GeocodingPending
   312			}
   313		}
   314		return report
   315	}

   319		legacy := LostPetEvent{

   322			ReportedAt:    r.ReportedAt,
   323			Location:      r.Location,

   331	func validateLostPetCanonicalFields(r LostPetReport) error {
   332		if err := validateLostPetLengths(r); err != nil {
   333			return err
   334		}
   335		if r.Species != "" && r.Species != "Dog" && r.Species != "Cat" && r.Species != "Bird" && r.Species != "Other" {
   336			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported species %q", r.Species)
   337		}
   338		if r.Status != LostPetStatusLost {
   339			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported lost-pet status %q", r.Status)
   340		}
   341		switch r.GeocodingStatus {
   342		case GeocodingPending:
   343			if r.Location == "" {
   344				return errors.New("domain: pending geocoding requires a location")
   345			}
   346			if r.Coordinates != nil {
   347				return errors.New("domain: pending geocoding cannot include coordinates")
   348			}
   349		case GeocodingUnavailable:
   350			if r.Coordinates != nil {
   351				return errors.New("domain: unavailable geocoding cannot include coordinates")
   352			}
   353		case GeocodingVerified:
   354			if r.Coordinates == nil {
   355				return errors.New("domain: verified geocoding requires coordinates")
   356			}
   357			if err := r.Coordinates.Validate(); err != nil {
   358				return err
   359			}
   360		default:
   361			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported geocoding status %q", r.GeocodingStatus)
   362		}
   363		return nil
   364	}

   578			{name: "primaryColor", value: r.PrimaryColor, limit: 100},
   579			{name: "description", value: r.Description, limit: 2000},
   580			{name: "reporterEmail", value: r.ReporterEmail, limit: 320},
   581			{name: "phone", value: r.Phone, limit: 64},
   582			{name: "imageObject", value: r.ImageObject, limit: 1024},
   583			{name: "location", value: r.Location, limit: 500},
   584		}
   585		for _, field := range fields {
   586			if utf8.RuneCountInString(field.value) > field.limit {
   587				return fmt.Errorf("domain: %s exceeds %d characters", field.name, field.limit)
   588			}
   589		}
   590		return nil

   111	// BeginImageUpload creates a V4 POST policy constrained to one generated key,
   112	// one supported media type, exact metadata, a short expiry, and MaxImageBytes.
   113	func (s *GCSImageStore) BeginImageUpload(ctx context.Context, intent ImageUploadIntent) (*ImageUploadGrant, error) {
   114		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   115			return nil, err
   116		}
   117		purposePath, ok := imagePathForPurpose(intent.Purpose)
   118		if !ok {
   119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported purpose %q", ErrInvalidImage, intent.Purpose)
   120		}
   121		contentType, extension, ok := supportedImageType(intent.ContentType)
   122		if !ok {
   123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported content type %q", ErrInvalidImage, intent.ContentType)
   124		}
   125		token, err := randomHex(16)
   126		if err != nil {
   127			return nil, err
   128		}
   129		reportID := purposePath.reportPrefix + token
   130		finalizeToken, err := randomHex(32)
   131		if err != nil {
   132			return nil, err
   133		}
   134		objectName := fmt.Sprintf("uploads/%s/%s/image%s", purposePath.objectSegment, reportID, extension)
   135		expiresAt := s.now().UTC().Add(uploadExpiry)
   136		policy, err := s.backend.GenerateSignedPostPolicyV4(objectName, &storage.PostPolicyV4Options{
   137			Expires: expiresAt,
   138			Fields: &storage.PolicyV4Fields{
   139				ContentType:         contentType,
   140				StatusCodeOnSuccess: http.StatusCreated,
   141				Metadata: map[string]string{
   142					metadataReportIDField:    reportID,
   143					metadataPurposeField:     string(intent.Purpose),
   144					metadataUploadTokenField: tokenDigest(finalizeToken),
   145					metadataFinalizeField:    strconv.FormatInt(expiresAt.Unix(), 10),
   146				},
   147			},
   148			Conditions: []storage.PostPolicyV4Condition{
   149				storage.ConditionContentLengthRange(1, uint64(MaxImageBytes)),
   150			},
   151		})
   152		if err != nil {
   153			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: sign GCS upload policy: %w", err)
   154		}
   155		return &ImageUploadGrant{
   156			UploadURL:     policy.URL,
   157			FormFields:    policy.Fields,
   158			ReportID:      reportID,
   159			FinalizeToken: finalizeToken,
   160			ObjectName:    objectName,
   161			ContentType:   contentType,
   162			MaxBytes:      MaxImageBytes,
   163			ExpiresAt:     expiresAt,
   164		}, nil
   165	}

   167	// FinalizeImage verifies immutable object attributes and decoded bytes before
   168	// copying the object into the private finalized namespace.
   169	func (s *GCSImageStore) FinalizeImage(ctx context.Context, reportID, objectName, finalizeToken string) (*FinalizedImage, error) {
   170		contentType, finalName, err := validateUploadBinding(reportID, objectName)
   171		if err != nil {
   172			return nil, err
   173		}
   174		purpose, _, ok := imagePurposeForPath(reportID, objectName, "uploads")
   175		if !ok {
   176			return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   177		}
   178	
   179		if attrs, attrsErr := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, finalName); attrsErr == nil {
   180			if !tokenMatches(attrs.Metadata[metadataUploadToken], finalizeToken) {
   181				return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   182			}
   183			if err := s.validateFinalizeDeadline(attrs.Metadata); err != nil {
   184				return nil, err
   185			}
   186			return finalizedFromAttrs(reportID, attrs)
   187		} else if !errors.Is(attrsErr, ErrNotFound) {
   188			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: inspect finalized GCS image: %w", attrsErr)
   189		}
   190	
   191		attrs, err := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, objectName)
   192		if err != nil {
   193			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: inspect uploaded GCS image: %w", err)
   194		}
   195		if attrs.Name != objectName || attrs.ContentType != contentType ||
   196			attrs.Metadata[metadataReportID] != reportID ||
   197			attrs.Metadata[metadataPurpose] != string(purpose) {
   198			return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   199		}
   200		if !tokenMatches(attrs.Metadata[metadataUploadToken], finalizeToken) {
   201			return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   202		}
   203		if err := s.validateFinalizeDeadline(attrs.Metadata); err != nil {
   204			return nil, err
   205		}
   206		if attrs.Size <= 0 || attrs.Size > MaxImageBytes {
   207			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: object size %d", ErrInvalidImage, attrs.Size)
   208		}
   209		data, err := s.backend.Read(ctx, objectName, attrs.Generation, MaxImageBytes+1)
   210		if err != nil {
   211			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: read uploaded GCS image: %w", err)
   212		}
   213		if int64(len(data)) != attrs.Size {
   214			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: object size changed during validation", ErrInvalidImage)
   215		}
   216		width, height, err := validateImage(data, contentType)
   217		if err != nil {
   218			return nil, err
   219		}
   220		finalAttrs, err := s.backend.Copy(ctx, finalName, objectName, attrs.Generation, gcsObjectAttrs{
   221			ContentType: contentType,
   222			Size:        attrs.Size,
   223			Metadata: map[string]string{
   224				metadataReportID:       reportID,
   225				metadataPurpose:        string(purpose),
   226				metadataWidth:          strconv.Itoa(width),
   227				metadataHeight:         strconv.Itoa(height),
   228				metadataUploadToken:    attrs.Metadata[metadataUploadToken],
   229				metadataFinalizeBefore: attrs.Metadata[metadataFinalizeBefore],
   230			},
   231		})
   232		if err != nil {
   233			if isPreconditionFailed(err) {
   234				if existing, attrsErr := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, finalName); attrsErr == nil {
   235					if !tokenMatches(existing.Metadata[metadataUploadToken], finalizeToken) {
   236						return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   237					}
   238					if err := s.validateFinalizeDeadline(existing.Metadata); err != nil {
   239						return nil, err
   240					}
   241					return finalizedFromAttrs(reportID, existing)
   242				}
   243			}
   244			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: finalize GCS image: %w", err)
   245		}
   246		if err := s.backend.Delete(ctx, objectName, attrs.Generation); err != nil {
   247			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: delete temporary GCS image: %w", err)
   248		}
   249		return finalizedFromAttrs(reportID, finalAttrs)
   250	}

   266	// GenerateImageReadURL creates a private, short-lived V4 GET capability.
   267	func (s *GCSImageStore) GenerateImageReadURL(ctx context.Context, objectName string, expiry time.Duration) (string, error) {
   268		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   269			return "", err
   270		}
   271		attrs, err := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, objectName)
   272		if err != nil {
   273			if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
   274				return "", ErrNotFinalized
   275			}
   276			return "", fmt.Errorf("blob: inspect private GCS image: %w", err)
   277		}
   278		if _, err := finalizedFromAttrs(finalizedReportID(objectName), attrs); err != nil {
   279			return "", ErrNotFinalized
   280		}
   281		if expiry <= 0 || expiry > maxReadExpiry {
   282			expiry = maxReadExpiry
   283		}
   284		readURL, err := s.backend.SignedURL(objectName, &storage.SignedURLOptions{
   285			Method:          http.MethodGet,
   286			Expires:         s.now().UTC().Add(expiry),
   287			Scheme:          storage.SigningSchemeV4,
   288			QueryParameters: nil,
   289		})
   290		if err != nil {
   291			return "", fmt.Errorf("blob: sign private GCS read URL: %w", err)
   292		}
   293		return readURL, nil
   294	}

   321	// CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImages deletes only old, valid finalized objects
   322	// that remain unreferenced across two durable-state checks. Listing is
   323	// cursor-backed and bounded; deletion is pinned to the inspected generation.
   324	func (s *GCSImageStore) CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImages(
   325		ctx context.Context,
   326		createdBefore time.Time,
   327		limit int,
   328		referenced FinalizedImageReferenceChecker,
   329	) (int, error) {
   330		return s.CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImagesForPurpose(
   331			ctx, ImagePurposeFoundPet, createdBefore, limit, referenced,
   332		)
   333	}
   334	
   335	// CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImagesForPurpose scopes reconciliation to one report
   336	// workflow's private namespace.
   337	func (s *GCSImageStore) CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImagesForPurpose(
   338		ctx context.Context,
   339		purpose ImagePurpose,
   340		createdBefore time.Time,
   341		limit int,
   342		referenced FinalizedImageReferenceChecker,
   343	) (int, error) {
   344		if referenced == nil {
   345			return 0, errors.New("blob: finalized image reference checker is required")
   346		}
   347		purposePath, ok := imagePathForPurpose(purpose)
   348		if !ok {
   349			return 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported purpose %q", ErrInvalidImage, purpose)
   350		}
   351		if limit <= 0 || limit > MaxOrphanCleanupBatch {
   352			limit = MaxOrphanCleanupBatch
   353		}
   354		s.cleanupMu.Lock()
   355		defer s.cleanupMu.Unlock()
   356	
   357		objects, nextCursor, err := s.backend.List(ctx, "images/"+purposePath.objectSegment+"/", s.cleanupCursor, limit)
   358		if err != nil {
   359			return 0, fmt.Errorf("blob: list finalized GCS images: %w", err)
   360		}
   361		s.cleanupCursor = nextCursor
   362		deleted := 0
   363		for _, candidate := range objects {
   364			if candidate.Created.IsZero() || !candidate.Created.Before(createdBefore) {
   365				continue
   366			}
   367			reportID := finalizedReportID(candidate.Name)
   368			if _, err := finalizedFromAttrs(reportID, candidate); err != nil {
   369				continue
   370			}
   371			isReferenced, err := referenced(ctx, reportID, candidate.Name)
   372			if err != nil {
   373				return deleted, fmt.Errorf("blob: check finalized image reference: %w", err)
   374			}
   375			if isReferenced {
   376				continue
   377			}
   378			current, err := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, candidate.Name)
   379			if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
   380				continue
   381			}
   382			if err != nil {
   383				return deleted, fmt.Errorf("blob: recheck finalized GCS image generation: %w", err)
   384			}
   385			if current.Generation != candidate.Generation {
   386				continue
   387			}
   388			isReferenced, err = referenced(ctx, reportID, candidate.Name)
   389			if err != nil {
   390				return deleted, fmt.Errorf("blob: recheck finalized image reference: %w", err)
   391			}
   392			if isReferenced {
   393				continue
   394			}
   395			if err := s.backend.Delete(ctx, candidate.Name, candidate.Generation); err != nil {
   396				return deleted, fmt.Errorf("blob: delete orphaned finalized GCS image: %w", err)
   397			}
   398			deleted++
   399		}
   400		return deleted, nil
   401	}

   406	func (s *GCSImageStore) validateFinalizeDeadline(metadata map[string]string) error {
   407		deadlineUnix, err := strconv.ParseInt(metadata[metadataFinalizeBefore], 10, 64)
   408		if err != nil || deadlineUnix <= 0 {
   409			return ErrUploadMismatch
   410		}
   411		if !s.now().UTC().Before(time.Unix(deadlineUnix, 0).UTC()) {
   412			return ErrUploadExpired
   413		}
   414		return nil
   415	}

   417	func validateUploadBinding(reportID, objectName string) (string, string, error) {
   418		if strings.TrimSpace(reportID) == "" || strings.Contains(reportID, "/") {
   419			return "", "", ErrUploadMismatch
   420		}
   421		_, purposePath, ok := imagePurposeForPath(reportID, objectName, "uploads")
   422		if !ok {
   423			return "", "", ErrUploadMismatch
   424		}
   425		prefix := "uploads/" + purposePath.objectSegment + "/" + reportID + "/image"
   426		extension := strings.TrimPrefix(objectName, prefix)
   427		var contentType string
   428		switch extension {
   429		case ".jpg":
   430			contentType = "image/jpeg"
   431		case ".png":
   432			contentType = "image/png"
   433		default:
   434			return "", "", ErrUploadMismatch
   435		}
   436		return contentType, "images/" + purposePath.objectSegment + "/" + reportID + "/image" + extension, nil
   437	}

   183	// HandleLostPet handles POST /lostPet HTTP requests.
   184	func (s *Service) HandleLostPet(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
   185		if r.Method != http.MethodPost {
   186			respondWithError(w, http.StatusMethodNotAllowed, "Method not allowed")
   187			return
   188		}
   189	
   190		ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(r.Context(), s.reportOperationTimeout)
   191		defer cancel()
   192		r = r.WithContext(ctx)
   193		r.Body = http.MaxBytesReader(w, r.Body, 1048576)
   194	
   195		var request struct {
   196			PetID           string                 `json:"petId"`
   197			PetName         string                 `json:"petName"`
   198			Species         string                 `json:"species"`
   199			Breed           string                 `json:"breed"`
   200			PrimaryColor    string                 `json:"primaryColor"`
   201			Description     string                 `json:"description"`
   202			ReporterEmail   string                 `json:"reporterEmail"`
   203			Phone           string                 `json:"phone"`
   204			ImageObject     string                 `json:"imageObject"`
   205			ReportedAt      time.Time              `json:"reportedAt"`
   206			Location        string                 `json:"location"`
   207			GeocodingStatus domain.GeocodingStatus `json:"geocodingStatus"`
   208			Coordinates     *domain.LocationPoint  `json:"coordinates"`
   209		}
   210		if err := json.NewDecoder(r.Body).Decode(&request); err != nil {
   211			respondWithError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Invalid JSON payload: %v", err))
   212			return
   213		}
   214		if strings.TrimSpace(request.ImageObject) != "" {
   215			if s.imageStore == nil {
   216				respondWithError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, "A generated private image upload is required")
   217				return
   218			}
   219			finalized, err := s.imageStore.FinalizeImageForPurpose(
   220				r.Context(), blob.ImagePurposeLostPet, request.PetID, request.ImageObject,
   221				r.Header.Get("X-PetSpotR-Upload-Token"),
   222			)
   223			if errors.Is(err, blob.ErrInvalidImage) || errors.Is(err, blob.ErrUploadMismatch) ||
   224				errors.Is(err, blob.ErrUploadExpired) || errors.Is(err, blob.ErrNotFound) ||
   225				errors.Is(err, blob.ErrNotFinalized) {
   226				respondWithError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Image finalization failed: %v", err))
   227				return
   228			}
   229			if err != nil {
   230				log.Printf("LostPet image finalization failed: %v", err)
   231				respondWithError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, "Image finalization failed")
   232				return
   233			}
   234			request.ImageObject = finalized.ObjectName
   235		}
   236	
   237		result, err := s.ReportLostPet(r.Context(), ReportCommand{
   238			PetID:           request.PetID,
   239			PetName:         request.PetName,
   240			Species:         request.Species,
   241			Breed:           request.Breed,
   242			PrimaryColor:    request.PrimaryColor,
   243			Description:     request.Description,
   244			ReporterEmail:   request.ReporterEmail,
   245			Phone:           request.Phone,
   246			ImageObject:     request.ImageObject,
   247			ReportedAt:      request.ReportedAt,
   248			Location:        request.Location,
   249			GeocodingStatus: request.GeocodingStatus,
   250			Coordinates:     request.Coordinates,
   251		}, ReportMetadata{
   252			CorrelationID: r.Header.Get("X-Correlation-ID"),
   253			TraceID:       r.Header.Get("X-Trace-ID"),
   254		})
   255		switch {
   256		case errors.Is(err, ErrInvalidReport):
   257			respondWithError(w, http.StatusBadRequest, fmt.Sprintf("Event validation failed: %v", InvalidReportCause(err)))
   258			return
   259		case errors.Is(err, store.ErrConflict):
   260			respondWithError(w, http.StatusConflict, "A different report already exists for this pet ID")
   261			return
   262		case err != nil:
   263			respondWithError(w, http.StatusInternalServerError, err.Error())
   264			return
   265		}
   266	
   267		w.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
   268		w.WriteHeader(http.StatusCreated)
   269		_ = json.NewEncoder(w).Encode(map[string]string{
   270			"status":  "success",
   271			"petId":   result.PetID,
   272			"eventId": result.EventID,
   273		})
   274	}

   276	// ReportLostPet validates and durably accepts one lost-pet report before
   277	// attempting best-effort publication from its transactional outbox.
   278	func (s *Service) ReportLostPet(
   279		ctx context.Context,
   280		command ReportCommand,
   281		metadata ReportMetadata,
   282	) (ReportResult, error) {
   283		report := domain.NormalizeLostPetReport(domain.LostPetReport{
   284			PetID:           command.PetID,
   285			PetName:         command.PetName,
   286			Species:         command.Species,
   287			Breed:           command.Breed,
   288			PrimaryColor:    command.PrimaryColor,
   289			Description:     command.Description,
   290			ReporterEmail:   command.ReporterEmail,
   291			Phone:           command.Phone,
   292			ImageObject:     command.ImageObject,
   293			ReportedAt:      command.ReportedAt,
   294			Location:        command.Location,
   295			GeocodingStatus: command.GeocodingStatus,
   296			Coordinates:     command.Coordinates,
   297		})
   298		if err := report.Validate(); err != nil {
   299			return ReportResult{}, &invalidReportError{cause: err}
   300		}
   301		persistedReport, contact := report.Persisted()
   302		if err := contact.Validate(); err != nil {
   303			return ReportResult{}, &invalidReportError{cause: err}
   304		}
   305	
   306		// Payload-v1 persisted state used the caller-provided key even though the
   307		// envelope normalized its aggregate ID. Check that exact legacy key before
   308		// creating canonical state so an old report such as " lost-123 " cannot be
   309		// duplicated under the normalized "lost-123" key after an upgrade.
   310		if command.PetID != report.PetID {
   311			legacyResult, legacyExists, matches, err := s.matchPersistedRetry(ctx, command.PetID, report)
   312			if err != nil {
   313				return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to check persisted report retry: %w", err)
   314			}
   315			if matches {
   316				return legacyResult, nil
   317			}
   318			if legacyExists {
   319				return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to save state and outbox: %w", store.ErrConflict)
   320			}
   321		}
   322	
   323		stateData, err := json.Marshal(persistedReport)
   324		if err != nil {
   325			return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal lost-pet report: %w", err)
   326		}
   327		contactData, err := json.Marshal(contact)
   328		if err != nil {
   329			return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal lost-pet contact: %w", err)
   330		}
   331		eventData, err := json.Marshal(report.ReportedEvent())
   332		if err != nil {
   333			return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal lost-pet event: %w", err)
   334		}
   335		occurredAt := report.ReportedAt
   336		if occurredAt.IsZero() {
   337			occurredAt = time.Now().UTC()
   338		}
   339		envelope, err := domain.NewEventEnvelope(domain.EventEnvelopeInput{
   340			Type:             domain.EventTypeLostPetReported,
   341			OccurredAt:       occurredAt,
   342			CorrelationID:    metadata.CorrelationID,
   343			TraceID:          metadata.TraceID,
   344			AggregateID:      report.PetID,
   345			AggregateVersion: 1,
   346			PayloadVersion:   domain.LostPetReportedPayloadVersion,
   347			Payload:          eventData,
   348		})
   349		if err != nil {
   350			return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to create event envelope: %w", err)
   351		}
   352		envelopeData, err := json.Marshal(envelope)
   353		if err != nil {
   354			return ReportResult{}, fmt.Errorf("failed to marshal event envelope: %w", err)
   355		}

   493		expectedData, err := json.Marshal(expectedRecord)

   502		if err != nil {

   520		}
   521		if !bytes.Equal(previousContactData, expectedContactData) {
   522			return ReportResult{}, false, nil
   523		}
   524	
   525		variants := []struct {
   526			version int
   527			payload any
   528		}{
   529			{version: domain.LostPetReportedPayloadVersion, payload: report.ReportedEvent()},
   530			{version: domain.LostPetReportedRedactedPayloadVersion, payload: report.ReportedEventV3()},
   531			{version: domain.LostPetReportedContactPayloadVersion, payload: report.ReportedEventV2()},
   532		}

   542				AggregateVersion: 1,
   543				PayloadVersion:   variant.version,
   544				Payload:          payload,
   545			})
   546			if err != nil {
   547				continue
   548			}
   549			result, matches, err := s.matchPersistedOutbox(ctx, previous.PetID, envelope)
   550			if err != nil || matches {
   551				return result, matches, err
   552			}
   553		}
   554		return ReportResult{}, false, nil
   555	}

   321			ReporterEmail: r.ReporterEmail,
   322			ReportedAt:    r.ReportedAt,
   323			Location:      r.Location,

   331	func validateLostPetCanonicalFields(r LostPetReport) error {
   332		if err := validateLostPetLengths(r); err != nil {
   333			return err
   334		}
   335		if r.Species != "" && r.Species != "Dog" && r.Species != "Cat" && r.Species != "Bird" && r.Species != "Other" {
   336			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported species %q", r.Species)
   337		}
   338		if r.Status != LostPetStatusLost {
   339			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported lost-pet status %q", r.Status)
   340		}
   341		switch r.GeocodingStatus {
   342		case GeocodingPending:
   343			if r.Location == "" {
   344				return errors.New("domain: pending geocoding requires a location")
   345			}
   346			if r.Coordinates != nil {
   347				return errors.New("domain: pending geocoding cannot include coordinates")
   348			}
   349		case GeocodingUnavailable:
   350			if r.Coordinates != nil {
   351				return errors.New("domain: unavailable geocoding cannot include coordinates")
   352			}
   353		case GeocodingVerified:
   354			if r.Coordinates == nil {
   355				return errors.New("domain: verified geocoding requires coordinates")
   356			}
   357			if err := r.Coordinates.Validate(); err != nil {
   358				return err
   359			}
   360		default:
   361			return fmt.Errorf("domain: unsupported geocoding status %q", r.GeocodingStatus)
   362		}
   363		return nil
   364	}

   111	// BeginImageUpload creates a V4 POST policy constrained to one generated key,
   112	// one supported media type, exact metadata, a short expiry, and MaxImageBytes.
   113	func (s *GCSImageStore) BeginImageUpload(ctx context.Context, intent ImageUploadIntent) (*ImageUploadGrant, error) {
   114		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   115			return nil, err
   116		}
   117		purposePath, ok := imagePathForPurpose(intent.Purpose)
   118		if !ok {
   119			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported purpose %q", ErrInvalidImage, intent.Purpose)
   120		}
   121		contentType, extension, ok := supportedImageType(intent.ContentType)
   122		if !ok {
   123			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported content type %q", ErrInvalidImage, intent.ContentType)
   124		}
   125		token, err := randomHex(16)
   126		if err != nil {
   127			return nil, err
   128		}
   129		reportID := purposePath.reportPrefix + token
   130		finalizeToken, err := randomHex(32)
   131		if err != nil {
   132			return nil, err
   133		}
   134		objectName := fmt.Sprintf("uploads/%s/%s/image%s", purposePath.objectSegment, reportID, extension)
   135		expiresAt := s.now().UTC().Add(uploadExpiry)
   136		policy, err := s.backend.GenerateSignedPostPolicyV4(objectName, &storage.PostPolicyV4Options{
   137			Expires: expiresAt,
   138			Fields: &storage.PolicyV4Fields{
   139				ContentType:         contentType,
   140				StatusCodeOnSuccess: http.StatusCreated,
   141				Metadata: map[string]string{
   142					metadataReportIDField:    reportID,
   143					metadataPurposeField:     string(intent.Purpose),
   144					metadataUploadTokenField: tokenDigest(finalizeToken),
   145					metadataFinalizeField:    strconv.FormatInt(expiresAt.Unix(), 10),
   146				},
   147			},
   148			Conditions: []storage.PostPolicyV4Condition{
   149				storage.ConditionContentLengthRange(1, uint64(MaxImageBytes)),
   150			},
   151		})
   152		if err != nil {
   153			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: sign GCS upload policy: %w", err)
   154		}
   155		return &ImageUploadGrant{
   156			UploadURL:     policy.URL,
   157			FormFields:    policy.Fields,
   158			ReportID:      reportID,
   159			FinalizeToken: finalizeToken,
   160			ObjectName:    objectName,
   161			ContentType:   contentType,
   162			MaxBytes:      MaxImageBytes,
   163			ExpiresAt:     expiresAt,
   164		}, nil
   165	}

   167	// FinalizeImage verifies immutable object attributes and decoded bytes before
   168	// copying the object into the private finalized namespace.
   169	func (s *GCSImageStore) FinalizeImage(ctx context.Context, reportID, objectName, finalizeToken string) (*FinalizedImage, error) {
   170		contentType, finalName, err := validateUploadBinding(reportID, objectName)
   171		if err != nil {
   172			return nil, err
   173		}
   174		purpose, _, ok := imagePurposeForPath(reportID, objectName, "uploads")
   175		if !ok {
   176			return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   177		}
   178	
   179		if attrs, attrsErr := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, finalName); attrsErr == nil {
   180			if !tokenMatches(attrs.Metadata[metadataUploadToken], finalizeToken) {
   181				return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   182			}
   183			if err := s.validateFinalizeDeadline(attrs.Metadata); err != nil {
   184				return nil, err
   185			}
   186			return finalizedFromAttrs(reportID, attrs)
   187		} else if !errors.Is(attrsErr, ErrNotFound) {
   188			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: inspect finalized GCS image: %w", attrsErr)
   189		}
   190	
   191		attrs, err := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, objectName)
   192		if err != nil {
   193			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: inspect uploaded GCS image: %w", err)
   194		}
   195		if attrs.Name != objectName || attrs.ContentType != contentType ||
   196			attrs.Metadata[metadataReportID] != reportID ||
   197			attrs.Metadata[metadataPurpose] != string(purpose) {
   198			return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   199		}
   200		if !tokenMatches(attrs.Metadata[metadataUploadToken], finalizeToken) {
   201			return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   202		}
   203		if err := s.validateFinalizeDeadline(attrs.Metadata); err != nil {
   204			return nil, err
   205		}
   206		if attrs.Size <= 0 || attrs.Size > MaxImageBytes {
   207			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: object size %d", ErrInvalidImage, attrs.Size)
   208		}
   209		data, err := s.backend.Read(ctx, objectName, attrs.Generation, MaxImageBytes+1)
   210		if err != nil {
   211			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: read uploaded GCS image: %w", err)
   212		}
   213		if int64(len(data)) != attrs.Size {
   214			return nil, fmt.Errorf("%w: object size changed during validation", ErrInvalidImage)
   215		}
   216		width, height, err := validateImage(data, contentType)
   217		if err != nil {
   218			return nil, err
   219		}
   220		finalAttrs, err := s.backend.Copy(ctx, finalName, objectName, attrs.Generation, gcsObjectAttrs{
   221			ContentType: contentType,
   222			Size:        attrs.Size,
   223			Metadata: map[string]string{
   224				metadataReportID:       reportID,
   225				metadataPurpose:        string(purpose),
   226				metadataWidth:          strconv.Itoa(width),
   227				metadataHeight:         strconv.Itoa(height),
   228				metadataUploadToken:    attrs.Metadata[metadataUploadToken],
   229				metadataFinalizeBefore: attrs.Metadata[metadataFinalizeBefore],
   230			},
   231		})
   232		if err != nil {
   233			if isPreconditionFailed(err) {
   234				if existing, attrsErr := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, finalName); attrsErr == nil {
   235					if !tokenMatches(existing.Metadata[metadataUploadToken], finalizeToken) {
   236						return nil, ErrUploadMismatch
   237					}
   238					if err := s.validateFinalizeDeadline(existing.Metadata); err != nil {
   239						return nil, err
   240					}
   241					return finalizedFromAttrs(reportID, existing)
   242				}
   243			}
   244			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: finalize GCS image: %w", err)
   245		}
   246		if err := s.backend.Delete(ctx, objectName, attrs.Generation); err != nil {
   247			return nil, fmt.Errorf("blob: delete temporary GCS image: %w", err)
   248		}
   249		return finalizedFromAttrs(reportID, finalAttrs)
   250	}

   266	// GenerateImageReadURL creates a private, short-lived V4 GET capability.
   267	func (s *GCSImageStore) GenerateImageReadURL(ctx context.Context, objectName string, expiry time.Duration) (string, error) {
   268		if err := ctx.Err(); err != nil {
   269			return "", err
   270		}
   271		attrs, err := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, objectName)
   272		if err != nil {
   273			if errors.Is(err, ErrNotFound) {
   274				return "", ErrNotFinalized
   275			}
   276			return "", fmt.Errorf("blob: inspect private GCS image: %w", err)
   277		}
   278		if _, err := finalizedFromAttrs(finalizedReportID(objectName), attrs); err != nil {
   279			return "", ErrNotFinalized
   280		}
   281		if expiry <= 0 || expiry > maxReadExpiry {
   282			expiry = maxReadExpiry
   283		}
   284		readURL, err := s.backend.SignedURL(objectName, &storage.SignedURLOptions{
   285			Method:          http.MethodGet,
   286			Expires:         s.now().UTC().Add(expiry),
   287			Scheme:          storage.SigningSchemeV4,
   288			QueryParameters: nil,
   289		})
   290		if err != nil {
   291			return "", fmt.Errorf("blob: sign private GCS read URL: %w", err)
   292		}
   293		return readURL, nil
   294	}

   321	// CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImages deletes only old, valid finalized objects
   322	// that remain unreferenced across two durable-state checks. Listing is
   323	// cursor-backed and bounded; deletion is pinned to the inspected generation.
   324	func (s *GCSImageStore) CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImages(
   325		ctx context.Context,
   326		createdBefore time.Time,
   327		limit int,
   328		referenced FinalizedImageReferenceChecker,
   329	) (int, error) {
   330		return s.CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImagesForPurpose(
   331			ctx, ImagePurposeFoundPet, createdBefore, limit, referenced,
   332		)
   333	}
   334	
   335	// CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImagesForPurpose scopes reconciliation to one report
   336	// workflow's private namespace.
   337	func (s *GCSImageStore) CleanupOrphanedFinalizedImagesForPurpose(
   338		ctx context.Context,
   339		purpose ImagePurpose,
   340		createdBefore time.Time,
   341		limit int,
   342		referenced FinalizedImageReferenceChecker,
   343	) (int, error) {
   344		if referenced == nil {
   345			return 0, errors.New("blob: finalized image reference checker is required")
   346		}
   347		purposePath, ok := imagePathForPurpose(purpose)
   348		if !ok {
   349			return 0, fmt.Errorf("%w: unsupported purpose %q", ErrInvalidImage, purpose)
   350		}
   351		if limit <= 0 || limit > MaxOrphanCleanupBatch {
   352			limit = MaxOrphanCleanupBatch
   353		}
   354		s.cleanupMu.Lock()
   355		defer s.cleanupMu.Unlock()
   356	
   357		objects, nextCursor, err := s.backend.List(ctx, "images/"+purposePath.objectSegment+"/", s.cleanupCursor, limit)
   358		if err != nil {
   359			return 0, fmt.Errorf("blob: list finalized GCS images: %w", err)
   360		}
   361		s.cleanupCursor = nextCursor
   362		deleted := 0
   363		for _, candidate := range objects {
   364			if candidate.Created.IsZero() || !candidate.Created.Before(createdBefore) {
   365				continue
   366			}
   367			reportID := finalizedReportID(candidate.Name)
   368			if _, err := finalizedFromAttrs(reportID, candidate); err != nil {
   369				continue
   370			}
   371			isReferenced, err := referenced(ctx, reportID, candidate.Name)
   372			if err != nil {
   373				return deleted, fmt.Errorf("blob: check finalized image reference: %w", err)
   374			}
   375			if isReferenced {
   376				continue
   377			}
   378			current, err := s.backend.Attrs(ctx, candidate.Name)

   132	// application and returns the normalized canonical integration event. Raw
   133	// payloads predate envelopes and are therefore interpreted as payload v1.
   134	func DecodeLostPetReported(data []byte) (LostPetReportedV4, *EventEnvelope, error) {
   135		var payload json.RawMessage
   136		envelope, err := DecodeEventPayload(data, EventTypeLostPetReported, &payload)
   137		if err != nil {

   139		}
